messages.author: 5f8b48f87aca80cb
messages.subject: Outgoing request on shinyapps.io app
parts:
Hi all,
I'm trying to create a shiny app using data hosted by the St. Louis Federal Reserve (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/). For some reason when I'm trying to make an outgoing request using the FredR package, the data never gets retrieved on my deployed app. It also doesn't generate an error.

This app works on my local but once deployed it doesn't return data from the FRED database. Does anyone know what might be causing this?

Thanks for the help!

- Tim

messages.author: 5f8b48f87aca80cb
messages.subject: Re: Outgoing request on shinyapps.io app
parts:
Actually the data is delivered (printed in the log file) but then never rendered in the DataTable, do you know what might be causing this?

  search_table <- eventReactive(input$go, 
      {withProgress(message = 'Loading query', {
    print(data.table(fredr_search(search_text = input$query)))
        data.table(fredr_search(search_text = input$query))
  })
  })
  
  # Render search result
  output$table1 = DT::renderDataTable(search_table(),
                                      selection = list(target = 'row'))

Absolutely - thanks for the help. I substituted the queried data for mtcars, and the same issue seems to persist:
library(ggplot2)
library(dygraphs)
library(shiny)
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)
library(xts)
library(zoo)
library(fredr)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  
  
  # Search FRED - returns a function

search_table <- eventReactive(input$go, 
                                {
                                  withProgress(message = 'Loading query', {
data.table(mtcars)

})
                                })
  # Render search result
  output$table1 = DT::renderDataTable(search_table(),
                                      selection = list(target = 'row'))

})

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel('GNP Explorer App'),
  sidebarPanel(
    textInput("query", "Series search", "Query FRED here"),
    actionButton("go", "Search"),
    textOutput('rows_out'),
    actionButton("pull", "Pull data"),
    width = 3
  ),
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel('Available Series',
               dataTableOutput("table1"))
    )
  )))
